title: Koh Lanta top things to do
sub: The best days out on Lanta, best first. Tap a pin, tick what you've done.
tip: Rent a scooter, it's the easiest way round (the road south is steep, so check the brakes). The park and the cave both close in the late afternoon, so do them in the morning. Monkeys at Nui, Bamboo and the lighthouse will grab bags. For sunsets see the Sunsets tab.

places.name: Koh Rok & Koh Haa snorkel trip
notes: Best snorkelling round Lanta. Full day, about 1,100 baht, park fee extra
Big group boats get crowded. For a quieter day book a private longtail (Lanta Dream & Paradise, Klong Khong)

places.name: National Park & lighthouse
notes: Cliff-top lighthouse, twin bays, jungle loop trail
200 baht + 20 for the bike. Open 8:30 to 5:30. Wear trainers

places.name: Khao Mai Kaew Cave
notes: Proper adventure: jungle hike, ladders, bamboo bridges, one tight crawl
300 baht incl. guide + head torch. Go early. Friday closes 10am to 1:30pm

places.name: Lanta Old Town
notes: Wooden stilt houses over the water, cafés with sea views, good souvenirs
Street market Sat and Sun, 11am to 10pm

places.name: Nui Bay
notes: Small turquoise cove, calm and shallow. Go early to have it to yourself
Monkeys steal bags, worst after the bar shuts

places.name: Kantiang Bay
notes: Big, quiet, soft-sand bay with a few good bars
Bikes only, no car parking down the lane

places.name: Thung Yee Peng mangroves
notes: 800m boardwalk through the mangroves, 40 baht. Boat or kayak trips on top
Thung Yee Peng Seafood next door is a great lunch over the river

places.name: Long Beach (Phra Ae)
notes: Longest, easiest swimming beach. Bars and food all the way along

places.name: Bamboo Beach
notes: Wild white-sand beach near the park, a couple of beach bars
Very cheeky monkeys, keep away from the trees on the right
